This guide covers advanced programmatic workflows for the `Rwapor` package, including seasonal analysis, multi-year monitoring with DuckDB, and handling mixed-resolution datasets.

## 1. Seasonal Crop Water Productivity Analysis

This workflow demonstrates how to calculate seasonal indicators (AETI, RET, ETc, Yield, CWP) using user-provided crop masks and planting/harvest dates.

```r
library(Rwapor)
library(terra)

# ===== STEP 1: Prepare Input Data =====

# Load your crop mask (1 = crop, 0 or NA = non-crop)
crop_mask <- rast("path/to/wheat_mask_2023.tif")

# Load season start/end rasters (Julian day of year)
season_start <- rast("path/to/planting_date.tif") 
season_end   <- rast("path/to/harvest_date.tif")

# ===== STEP 2: Download Required WaPOR Data =====
bbox <- as.vector(ext(crop_mask))

for (var in c("L2-AETI-D", "L2-RET-D", "L2-NPP-D", "L2-PCP-D")) {
  wapor_map(region = bbox, variable = var,
            period = c("2023-01-01", "2023-12-31"), folder = "wapor_data")
}

# ===== STEP 3: Load and Harmonize =====
aeti_stack <- rast(list.files("wapor_data/L2-AETI-D", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE))
ret_stack  <- rast(list.files("wapor_data/L2-RET-D",  pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE))
npp_stack  <- rast(list.files("wapor_data/L2-NPP-D",  pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE))

crop_mask_h    <- wapor_harmonize_raster(crop_mask,    aeti_stack[[1]], method = "near")
season_start_h <- wapor_harmonize_raster(season_start, aeti_stack[[1]], method = "near")
season_end_h   <- wapor_harmonize_raster(season_end,   aeti_stack[[1]], method = "near")

# ===== STEP 4: Build Season Weights =====
weights <- wapor_build_season_weights(
  start_date     = "2023-01-01",
  end_date       = "2023-12-31",
  start_raster   = season_start_h,
  end_raster     = season_end_h,
  reference_year = 2023
)

# ===== STEP 5: Calculate Indicators =====
# Seasonal Actual ET
seasonal_aeti <- wapor_calc_seasonal_aeti(aeti_stack, weights$weights, crop_mask_h)$raster

# Crop Water Requirement (ETc)
crop_params <- wapor_crop_defaults("Winter Wheat")
kc_daily <- wapor_build_kc(
  kc_ini = crop_params$kc_ini, kc_mid = crop_params$kc_mid, kc_end = crop_params$kc_end,
  l_ini = 30, l_dev = 40, l_mid = 60, l_late = 30
)
kc_dekad <- wapor_aggregate_kc(kc_daily, weights$dekad_table, season_start = as.Date("2023-01-01"))
seasonal_etc <- wapor_calc_seasonal_etc(ret_stack, weights$weights, kc_dekad)

# Yield and Productivity
seasonal_npp <- wapor_masked_sum(npp_stack, weights$weights)
seasonal_yield <- wapor_calc_yield_npp(seasonal_npp, mc=crop_params$MC, hi=crop_params$HI)
cwp <- wapor_calc_cwp(seasonal_yield, seasonal_aeti, yield_unit = "t/ha")
adequacy <- wapor_calc_adequacy_etc(seasonal_aeti, seasonal_etc)
```

## 2. Continuous Monitoring with DuckDB

The monitoring module allows you to maintain a local "Data Cube" that stays synchronized with the WaPOR API.

```r
library(Rwapor)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = "monitoring.duckdb")
pivots <- sf::st_read("pivots.geojson")

# Sync only new data
wapor_run_monitoring(
  con          = con,
  farms_sf     = pivots,
  variables    = c("L3-AETI-D", "L1-RET-D"),
  period       = c("2020-01-01", "2024-04-20"),
  save_rasters = TRUE
)

# Extract a specific blob for custom analysis
blob_data <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT raster_blob FROM farm_rasters LIMIT 1")$raster_blob[[1]]
r <- wapor_raster_from_blob(blob_data)
```

## 3. Handling Mixed Resolutions (L1 vs L3)

When comparing Level 1 (250m) and Level 3 (30m) data, use `terra::resample` to align them.

```r
# Retrieve native blobs
r_aeti_l3 <- wapor_raster_from_blob(blob_aeti) # 30m
r_ret_l1  <- wapor_raster_from_blob(blob_ret)  # 250m

# Resample RET to match AETI grid
r_ret_aligned <- terra::resample(r_ret_l1, r_aeti_l3, method = "bilinear")

# Calculate indicator
r_ratio <- r_aeti_l3 / r_ret_aligned
```

## 4. Enhanced Analysis (Percentile Filtering)

Remove noisy edge pixels by recalculating statistics from saved blobs.

```r
# Recalculate Pivot A1 stats using only the top 95% of pixels
# (Discards the bottom 5% which are often contaminated by dry desert edges)
new_stats <- wapor_recalculate_stats_from_rasters(
  con = con,
  farm_id = "Pivot_A1",
  polygon = pivots[pivots$Name == "Pivot_A1", ],
  threshold_pct = 5
)
```
